sn3.18:1.2: nisinno kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn3.18:1.3: Idha mayham bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evam cetaso parivitakko udapādi ||
sn3.18:1.4: Svākhyāto Bhagavatā dhammo || so ca kho kalyāṇa-mittassa kalyāṇa-sahāyassa kalyāṇa-sampavaṅkassa || no pāpa-mittassa no papa-sahāyassa no pāpasampavaṅkassā ti || || 3.
sn3.18:2.1: Evam etam mahārāja evam etam mahārāja ||
sn3.18:2.2: svākhyāto mahārāja mayā dhammo || so ca kho kalyāṇa-mittassa kalyāṇasahāyassa kalyāṇa-sampavaṅkassa || no pāpa-mittassa no pāpasahāyassa no pāpa-sampavaṅkassā ti || || 4.
sn3.18:3.1: Ekam idāhaṃ mahārāja samayam Sakkesu viharāmi Sakyānaṃ nigame || || 5.
sn3.18:3.2: Atho kho mahārāja Ānando bhikkhu yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || Ekam antam nisinno kho mahārāja Ānando bhikkhu mam etad avoca || ||
sn3.18:3.3: Upaḍḍham idam bhante brahmacariyassa yad idaṃ
sn3.18:4.4: ti || || 6. Evam vuttāham mahārāja Ānandam bhikkhum etad avocam || Mā h-evam Ānanda mā h-evam Ānanda || sakalam eva h-idam Ānanda brahmacariyaṃ yad idaṃ kalyāṇa- mittatā kalyāṇa-sahāyatā kalyāṇa-sampavaṅkatā || kalyaṇamittassa etam Ānanda bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ kalyāṇamittassa kalyāṇa-sahāyassa kalyāṇa-sampavaṅkassa ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikam maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyam atthaṅgikam maggam bahulī-karissati || 7.
sn3.18:5.1: Kathañ ca Ānanda bhikkhu kalyāṇa-mitto kalyāṇasahāyo kalyāṇa-sampavaṅko ariyam aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulī-karoti || || 8. Idha Ānanda
sn3.18:5.2: bhikkhu sammā-diṭṭhim bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāga-nissitam nirodha-nissitaṃ vossaggapariṇamiṃ || sammā-saṅkappam bhāveti sammāvācam bhāveti || sammā-kammantam bhāveti || sammā-ājīvam bhāveti sammāvāyāmaṃ sammā-satim bhāveti || sammā-samādhiṃ bhāveti viveka-nissitaṃ virāga-nissitaṃ nirodha-nissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ || ||
sn3.18:5.3: Evaṃ kho Ānanda bhikkhu kalyāṇa-mitto kalyāṇa-sahāyo kalyāṇa-sampavaṅko ariyam atthaṅgikam maggam bhāveti ariyam atthaṅgikam maggam bahulī karoti || 9. Tad' aminā p-
sn3.18:5.4: etam Ānanda pariyāyena veditabbam || yathā sakalam ev-idam brahmacariyaṃ yad-idam kālyāṇamittatā kalyāṇa-sahāyatā kalyāṇa-sampavaṅkatā ti || || 10. Mamaṃ
sn3.18:6.1: hi Ānanda kalyāṇa-mittam āgamma jātidhammā sattā jātiyā parimuccanti || jarādhammā sattā jarāya parimuccanti || vyādhidhammā sattā vyādhiyā parimuccanti || maraṇa-dhammā sattā maraṇena parimuccanti || soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass-upāyāsa-dhammā sattā soka-paridevadukkha-domanass-upāyāsehi parimuccanti ||
sn3.18:6.2: Iminā kho etam Ānanda pariyāyena veditabbaṃ || yathā sakalam ev-idaṃ brahmacariyaṃ yad idaṃ kalyāṇa-mittatā kalyāṇa-sahāyatā kalyaṇa-sampavaṅkatāti || || 11.
sn3.18:7.1: Tasmāt iha te mahārāja evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ ||
sn3.18:7.2: kalyāṇamitto bhavissāmi kalyāṇa-sahāyo kalyāṇa-sampavaṅko ti || evaṃ
sn3.18:8.1: Kalyāṇa-mittassa te mahārāja kalyāṇa-sahāyassa kalyāṇa-sampavaṅkassa ayam eko dhammo upanissāya vihātabbo
sn3.18:9.1: Appamattassa te mahārāja viharato appamādam upanissāya itthāgārassa evam bhavissati || ||
sn3.18:9.2: Rājā kho appamatto viharati appamādam upanissāya ||
sn3.18:9.3: handa mayam pi appamattā viharāma appamādam upanissayā ti || || 13.
sn3.18:10.1: Appamattassa te mahārāja viharato appamādam upanissāya khattiyānam pi anuyuttānaṃ evam bhavissati || ||
sn3.18:10.2: Rājā kho appamatto viharati appamādam upanissāya || ||
sn3.18:10.3: Handa mayam pi appamattā viharāma appamādam upanissāyā ti || || 14.
sn3.18:11.1: Appamattassa te mahārāja viharato appamādam upanissāya negamajānapadassa pi evam bhavissati || ||
sn3.18:11.2: Rājā kho appamatto viharati appamādam upanissāya ||
sn3.18:11.3: handa mayam pi appamattā viharāma appamādam upanissāyā ti || || 15.
sn3.18:12.1: Appamattassa te mahārāja viharato appamādam upanissāya
sn3.18:13.2: itthāgāram pi guttaṃ rakkhitam bhavissati || kosakoṭṭhāgāram pi guttaṃ rakkhitam bhavissatīti || || 16.
